label: Age at index date
emr_source_or_rule: calc.age_at_index: registration DOB to enrolment index date

label: Presentation at index event
allowed_values: chronic_coronary_syndrome; STEMI; NSTEMI; unstable_angina; prior_mi_stable; prior_revascularisation_stable; other

label: CAD categories (all that apply)
allowed_values: chronic_coronary_syndrome; acute_coronary_syndrome; STEMI; NSTEMI; unstable_angina; previous_mi; previous_pci; previous_cabg; multivessel; left_main; cto; bifurcation

label: Presenting symptom
allowed_values: none; typical_angina; atypical_angina; non_anginal_pain; dyspnoea_equivalent; silent_ischaemia

label: Symptom onset to first medical contact (ACS)
Reperfusion strategy (STEMI)
allowed_values: primary_pci; pharmacoinvasive; thrombolysis_only; rescue_pci; none_late_presentation; none_other

label: Dyslipidaemia
emr_source_or_rule: emr.active_diagnosis: DX_DYSLIPIDAEMIA, DX_FH or on lipid-lowering therapy

label: Premature CAD in a first-degree relative
Chronic kidney disease (eGFR < 60 or diagnosis)
emr_source_or_rule: emr.active_diagnosis: DX_CKD or eGFR < 60 twice 90 d apart

label: Lipoprotein(a), as reported
emr_source_or_rule: emr.lab_ever: lab_results LPA_NMOL_L or LPA_MG_DL, unit kept

label: Coronary angiography for the index event
emr_source_or_rule: emr.index_angiogram: coronary_angiograms within 30 d of index

label: Initial treatment strategy
allowed_values: medical; pci; cabg; pci_planned; cabg_planned; hybrid

label: PCI for the index event
emr_source_or_rule: calc.index_pci: pci_procedures within 30 d of index, status final

label: CABG for the index event
emr_source_or_rule: calc.event_in_window: cabg within 90 d of index

label: Clinical indication
allowed_values: primary_pci_stemi; pharmacoinvasive; rescue_pci; nstemi; unstable_angina; chronic_coronary_syndrome; staged; silent_ischaemia; other

label: Vessels treated
allowed_values: LM; LAD; LCX; RCA; RAMUS; DIAGONAL; OM; PDA; PLV; SVG; LIMA; RIMA; RADIAL_GRAFT

label: Physiology assessment
allowed_values: none; FFR; iFR; RFR; QFR; other

label: Final TIMI 3 flow in every treated lesion
Procedural complications
allowed_values: none; dissection; perforation; no_reflow; side_branch_occlusion; acute_stent_thrombosis; access_bleeding; haematoma; pseudoaneurysm; contrast_nephropathy; arrhythmia; stroke; death; other

label: Dual antiplatelet therapy
emr_source_or_rule: calc.dapt: aspirin and P2Y12 inhibitor both active

label: Target lesion revascularisation since previous visit
emr_source_or_rule: calc.event_exists: pci or cabg on an index target lesion

label: Target vessel revascularisation since previous visit
emr_source_or_rule: calc.event_exists: pci or cabg in an index treated vessel

label: Any repeat revascularisation since previous visit
emr_source_or_rule: calc.event_exists: pci, cabg (excluding planned staged PCI)

label: Bleeding BARC 3 to 5 since previous visit
emr_source_or_rule: calc.event_exists: bleeding, BARC 3-5 by adjudication or reported severity

label: Heart failure hospitalisation since previous visit
DAPT status at visit
allowed_values: on_dapt; completed_as_planned; interrupted; stopped_bleeding; stopped_other; never_started
